title: 정돈된 베벨 금속
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: dark science-fantasy mobile game ECONOMY tab icon, a single standalone transparent sprite.
Create ONE coin, centered, filling about 80 percent of a square canvas. Subject is a single large front-facing gold/brass coin with a simple diamond rune. Actual transparent alpha background; absolutely no background color or checkerboard pixels.
This belongs beside a matching metallic shield combat tab icon in a dark navy dungeon interface with restrained steel beveled panels and fine gold accents. The coin must have comparable mid-level brightness and visual weight to a steel shield, not dominate the UI.
Palette: dark gunmetal outer silhouette, warm muted gold/brass face, tiny amber highlights. Readable at 20–24 pixels: very bold broad silhouette, thick simple structural shapes, minimal details.
Do not include any square frame, socket, button, badge backing, pedestal, surrounding ring outside the physical coin, text, labels, numbers, currency letters, watermark, particles, bloom, halo, exaggerated glow or bright cartoon-yellow saturation. No other objects. No ultra-thin patterning. Render only this new original icon, not a screenshot.
Style variant: Classic beveled gold coin, dark steel outer rim, broad embossed diamond at center, crisp bilateral symmetry. Restrained gleaming broad metal faces.
